## Scope and issue

- Related issue:
- Phase: development selection / later frozen canonical reproduction
- Track: environment preflight / compute / independent verification / research
- Model artifact (immutable revision):
- Logs/results archive:
- Provenance file:
- Checksum manifest:
- Submission bundle:
- Scientific status reported by verifier: accepted / rejected

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] The issue assigned or acknowledged this work before significant compute.
- [ ] I trained from the source commit recorded in `run_provenance.json`.
- [ ] The working tree was clean when preflight and training began.
- [ ] The run/spec fingerprint is included below and matches every artifact.
- [ ] All required tests and preflight checks passed before optimizer steps.
- [ ] The assigned phase completed without changing model, seeds, budgets, spec, evaluator, gates, or hyperparameters.
- [ ] Every planned candidate, seed, round, and curriculum level for the assigned phase is present, or the evidence is explicitly labelled incomplete/negative.
- [ ] Artifact verification passed and `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached.
- [ ] Development selection used only the training/development namespaces and produced no canonical/confirmation artifact.
- [ ] If this is a later frozen reproduction, canonical and confirmation access was authorized by a separately reviewed committed spec.
- [ ] The raw-model policy used zero controller interventions and zero token-truncated turns.
- [ ] Eligibility, survivor, acceptance, and decision records were generated by repository code, not hand-edited or manually overridden.
- [ ] I have read `KNOWN_TRAINING_FAILURE_MODES.md` and did not reuse a historical/noncanonical run directory.
- [ ] No episode or metric was selected, deleted, rerun, or manually edited.
- [ ] I used only my own compute and publication credentials.
- [ ] No credential, token, private log value, checkpoint, or large model binary is committed.
- [ ] Every interruption, restart, warning, manual intervention, and deviation is disclosed below.

## Frozen identity

- Source commit:
- Branch/PR commit:
- Spec SHA-256:
- Run fingerprint:
- Base model revision:
- GPU / VRAM / runtime:

## Results (generated, not hand-edited)

For development selection, link the complete campaign state, candidate/seed records,
raw development evidence, gates, round decisions, final selection decision, proposed
spec, manifests, and checksums. For a later authorized frozen reproduction, also link
the complete canonical/confirmation evidence required by its committed spec. Summarize
regressions and uncertainty as well as improvements. Negative or incomplete evidence
is useful but must remain labelled accurately.

## Interruptions, deviations, warnings, and limitations

None / describe completely.
